work_item: B04 ordinary CLI basic extraction/statistics, shared scientific-number identity and raw JSON Pointer correction
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Original CSV/JSON input -> sealed input -> unique Core -> exact selected data/statistics with original source evidence and typed stops -> actual caller-declared downstream consumption
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

observations: CSV statistics, CSV/JSON grouped statistics and direct statistics misread 1e3/2e3 as values 1/2 with unit e3, returning mean 3/2 e3 under COMMIT.
CSV values 1e1025/2e1025 returned a unit e1025 result, bypassing the scalar exponent limit.
JSON Pointer raw 1e400 failed in preliminary serde_json::Value parsing with INPUT_FAILURE/FAIL and no sealed bundle.
A successful Pointer preserved its selected raw 1.2300e+40 lexeme but trimmed original body whitespace in MeaningIR.
baseline_defects.driver_note: The initial diagnostic driver assumed every result had a sealed bundle and stopped after saving pointer-large. Existing seven results were recovered from saved stdout/inspection and only the remaining whitespace case was then executed; no baseline request was rerun.

corrections: Share decimal quantity classification across CSV statistics, CSV grouped statistics, JSON grouped statistics and direct-statistics intent. Unitless numeric tokens are delegated to the existing exact parser; maximal numeric prefixes cannot be shortened to invent a unit.

Apply the same precedence/maximal-prefix guard before unit addition, including ratios whose denominator has an exponent. Existing syntax, exponent, depth, operation and rational-bit bounds remain in the exact evaluators.
Preserve explicit unit suffixes such as 1e3m, 1 eV, 1e3 e3, 1/2m and 1/2 e3. No unit-name blacklist or floating-point conversion is introduced.

Separate Pointer header/body with horizontal whitespace and explicit LF/CRLF, retain the complete body, and remove preliminary serde_json::Value parsing. The source-preserving port parser validates the entire document and returns the selected raw lexeme.
Advance parser revision to v34 because Pointer body identity/admission and statistical intent classification change. No schema or persisted historical result is rewritten.

failure_and_return.cause: New test JSON macro omitted one outer rows-array closing bracket.
failure_and_return.correction: Restore the missing bracket; production code and expected results unchanged.

failure_and_return.cause: The new direct-statistics fixture supplied arithmetic expressions as bare JSON numeric elements; the existing contract requires quoted exact expressions.
failure_and_return.correction: Quote expressions in direct-statistics arrays; retain bare scientific number literals and the same mathematical expectations. Corrected component run passes both tests.

failure_and_return.cause: The test oracle searched d, without a row boundary and matched the header id, rather than the unquoted empty data row. Product span was correctly zero-width at byte 52.
failure_and_return.correction: Anchor data-row fragments to CRLF. Same raw/output and numeric expectations; all seven focused CLI tests then pass.

tests_and_route.route_method: Real CLI processes with fresh stores, actual authorized returned dependency reads and separate inspect of original requests/complete results. Pointer has no result-artifact dependency; CSV and JSON statistics retain their declared artifacts. Actual output bytes become new explicit requests.

additional_grouped_filter_run.overlap: One new shared-numeric test reruns; one existing three-case CSV grouped-statistics test is distinct. These are not two additional unique new tests.

tests_and_route.component_regression: Two existing exact arithmetic/unit-addition tests pass. New component tests cover source/body identity, scientific-statistics intent, quantity classification, rational/unit controls, exponent limits and correction.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; focused new routes, affected numeric components and selected existing regressions with workspace all-target compile/lint. No complete B04, R2 or current-workspace runtime acceptance claim.

route_observations.evidence: Non-first quoted header with a space; six exact string cells including comma, quoted CRLF, quoted empty, unquoted zero-width empty, large integer-looking string and escaped quotes. Header-only returns []. Every complete source/output span and exact parameters are checked.

Two-value exact decimals, 1e3/2e3 scientific numbers, 1 km/500 m with exact conversion, and expressions 1e3/2 plus 1e3-2e3. All numeric fields, input/normalized/sorted values, units, original header/member spans and report/artifact equality are checked. CSV report spans have no output offsets.

LF and CRLF headers preserve the entire padded UTF-8 body. Five selections check exact 1.2300e+40, 1e400, escaped string, numeric array and root lexemes. COMMIT/COMPUTED, render hash, dependencies=[], original request/body and complete result match separate inspect. No Japanese Pointer grammar is claimed.

Escaped nested Pointer, root array and singleton retain complete source hash and array/number spans. [1.20,-0,3e-1,2] yields sum 7/2, mean 7/8, median 3/4, population variance 987/1600 and sample variance 329/400. Singleton has null sample variance. Spans carry raw text/index, not individual digest fields.

Two real Pointer-selected arrays feed root JSON statistics and then actual report statistics-field projection, checking raw source/output field maps. A real CSV-selected string array feeds Pointer /0. These are caller-fed explicit requests, not automatic numeric coercion or an inferred Core plan.

CSV/JSON grouped and direct statistics share explicit numeric expectations for positive/negative exponents and quoted exact expressions. Two normal arithmetic cases verify 3000 and 3/4000. Component controls preserve explicit e3/eV, scientific quantities and rational quantities.

languages: English headers or ASCII arithmetic/statistics inputs
route_observations.evidence: Missing/duplicate CSV headers, bare LF, empty/mixed/incompatible statistics, Pointer escape/index/missing/duplicate/outside-selected/malformed/Unicode-whitespace errors, non-array/empty/mixed/nested JSON statistics and unsupported suffixes. Ten exponent stops exercise five shared callers with 1e1025 and 1e1025/m. Every stop is SUSPEND/UNKNOWN with no result dependency and original request/complete durable inspection.

versioned_recomputation_boundary: All eight exact input-ID/version-1 retries preserve their historical result, including wrong COMMIT and old input FAIL. Explicit version 2 uses v34, produces corrected values/raw selection or EXPONENT_LIMIT suspension, and retains every original result in prior_results.
observable_classification_change: Malformed Pointer bodies previously failed during input pre-parsing; they now reach the document port and suspend as DOCUMENT_OPERATION_FAILURE with the underlying document code. Invalid Pointer prefixes still fail at input admission; that unchanged prefix-failure path was not part of the final 33 CLI stop cases.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: Authored fixed examples are scoped QC, not an independent held-out B04 acceptance population.
Symbolic unit labels such as e and e- remain part of the existing quantity grammar; this work does not claim rejection of every incomplete exponent-like spelling.
Pointer reports raw selected JSON and no result artifact; no synthetic per-value source-map artifact or implicit chained Core plan was added.
Broader extraction/statistical populations, resource-boundary matrices, full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected normal extraction/statistics and typed-stop routes plus two observed causes corrected, not complete capability acceptance

traceability_update: B04 trace adds the observed CsvSelect and legacy JsonPointer entry-to-consumer routes and current scoped results; the observation paths add language.rs for shared numeric classification. Requirement/disposition/acceptance and population are preserved.
